001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.BoolDomain;
005
006/**
007 * left `op` right + offset
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class IrCompare extends IrAbstractBool {
012
013    private final IrIntExpr left;
014    private final Op op;
015    private final IrIntExpr right;
016
017    IrCompare(IrIntExpr left, Op op, IrIntExpr right, BoolDomain domain) {
018        super(domain);
019        this.left = Check.notNull(left);
020        this.op = Check.notNull(op);
021        this.right = Check.notNull(right);
022    }
023
024    public IrIntExpr getLeft() {
025        return left;
026    }
027
028    public Op getOp() {
029        return op;
030    }
031
032    public IrIntExpr getRight() {
033        return right;
034    }
035
036    @Override
037    public IrBoolExpr negate() {
038        switch (op) {
039            case Equal:
040                return new IrCompare(left, Op.NotEqual, right, getDomain().invert());
041            case NotEqual:
042                return new IrCompare(left, Op.Equal, right, getDomain().invert());
043            case LessThanEqual:
044                return Irs.lessThan(right, left);
045            default:
046                throw new IllegalStateException();
047        }
048    }
049
050    @Override
051    public boolean isNegative() {
052        return false;
053    }
054
055    @Override
056    public <A, B> B accept(IrBoolExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
057        return visitor.visit(this, a);
058    }
059
060    @Override
061    public <A, B> B accept(IrIntExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
062        return visitor.visit(this, a);
063    }
064
065    @Override
066    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
067        if (obj instanceof IrCompare) {
068            IrCompare other = (IrCompare) obj;
069            return left.equals(other.left) && op.equals(other.op)
070                    && right.equals(other.right) && super.equals(other);
071        }
072        return false;
073    }
074
075    @Override
076    public int hashCode() {
077        // op.hashCode() can change between runs which makes the output change
078        // every time.
079        return left.hashCode() ^ op.ordinal() ^ right.hashCode();
080    }
081
082    @Override
083    public String toString() {
084        return left + " " + op.getSyntax() + " " + right;
085    }
086
087    public static enum Op {
088
089        Equal("="),
090        NotEqual("!="),
091        LessThanEqual("<=");
092        private final String syntax;
093
094        Op(String syntax) {
095            this.syntax = syntax;
096        }
097
098        public String getSyntax() {
099            return syntax;
100        }
101
102        public boolean isEquality() {
103            switch (this) {
104                case Equal:
105                case NotEqual:
106                    return true;
107                default:
108                    return false;
109            }
110        }
111
112        public boolean isInequality() {
113            return !isEquality();
114        }
115    }
116}
